WITH customer_years AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(toYear(DateKey)) AS cohort_year,
        max(toYear(DateKey)) AS last_purchase_year
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT
    cohort_year,
    count() AS cohort_customers,
    countIf(last_purchase_year > cohort_year) AS customers_who_returned_in_later_year,
    countIf(last_purchase_year > cohort_year) * 1.0 / nullIf(count(), 0) AS return_fraction
FROM customer_years
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year
